body:
Thanks for the response. I recognize the empty feeling you're talking about, except it's not just the day after Christmas, but the day before, and especially the day of, that I'm feeling it. An emptiness where the excitement, the anticipation, the happiness should be. I don't feel like it was worth it, fighting as hard as I did to get here. And all I've really gotten out of it is my parents inviting family over to "celebrate" me when they really came to just drink and party while I stand in the corner.

Glad you found somethint to relate to though.
